description: Defines the WebSocketContext template class for managing WebSocket server/client contexts, including socket event handlers, fragment handling, compression, and lifecycle management within the uWS namespace.

classes.name: WebSocketContext
classes.description: Template class managing WebSocket server/client context, handling socket events, message processing, and lifecycle within the uWS namespace.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new WebSocketContext as a child of a parent socket context, initializing with a topic tree.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes socket event handlers for WebSocket lifecycle events, data, writable, end, timeout, and long timeout.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Cleans up and frees the WebSocketContext and associated data.

methods.name: getSocketContext
methods.description: Returns the underlying socket context pointer.

methods.name: getExt
methods.description: Retrieves the extended WebSocketContextData associated with this context.

methods.name: setCompressed
methods.description: Sets the compression status for a WebSocket frame if negotiated.

methods.name: forceClose
methods.description: Closes a WebSocket connection with an optional reason.

methods.name: handleFragment
methods.description: Handles WebSocket message fragments, including decompression, UTF-8 validation, and message assembly.

methods.name: refusePayloadLength
methods.description: Checks if payload length exceeds maximum allowed, refusing if so.
